tours.title: Murree Hills and Patriata
tours.summary: Mall Road, Kashmir Point and the Patriata chairlift, with a night at our own hotel on The Mall.
tours.alt: Patriata cable car cabins above forested hills near Murree
plan: Drive from Islamabad (about 1.5 hours). Check in at Al-Maaz Hotel on The Mall. Evening walk along Mall Road, the GPO and Kashmir Point.
Morning at Patriata for the chairlift and cable car. Stop at Pindi Point, then drive back to Islamabad.
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Galiyat: Ayubia and Nathia Gali
tours.summary: Pine forests, the Ayubia chairlift, the Pipeline Track and the ridges of Nathia Gali.
tours.alt: Forested ridges of Ayubia in the Galiyat
plan: From Murree through Changla Gali to Ayubia for the chairlift and the Pipeline Track walk to Dunga Gali. Evening in Nathia Gali.
Morning walk to Mukshpuri or Miranjani viewpoints, then return through Abbottabad or Murree.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Abbottabad, Balakot and Shogran
tours.summary: Abbottabad, Mansehra and Balakot, then Kiwai, Shogran and the Siri Paye meadows.
tours.alt: Siri Paye meadow and pond above Shogran
plan: Islamabad to Abbottabad for Shimla Hill, then on through Mansehra to Balakot on the Kunhar River.
Kiwai waterfall, then up to Shogran. Jeep to the Siri Paye meadows.
Morning in Shogran, then back to Islamabad through Mansehra and Abbottabad.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Naran, Kaghan and Saif-ul-Malook
tours.summary: The Kunhar River valley, Lake Saif-ul-Malook and Babusar Top.
tours.alt: Lake Saif-ul-Malook with snowy peaks reflected in the water
plan: Drive to Naran through Abbottabad, Mansehra and Balakot along the Kunhar River.
Jeep to Lake Saif-ul-Malook. Afternoon at leisure in Naran.
Lulusar Lake and Babusar Top, when the pass is open.
Return to Islamabad, stopping at Kiwai or Shogran if time allows.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package
tours.note: The road to Naran and upper Kaghan is closed by snow in winter. In those months we suggest Kiwai and Shogran instead.

tours.title: Neelum Valley, Kashmir
tours.summary: Riverside villages, Sharda and the meadows of Arang Kel.
tours.alt: Green slopes along the Neelum River
plan: Islamabad to Muzaffarabad, then up the valley to Keran.
Continue to Sharda. Visit the Sharda ruins and riverside.
Kel, then the chairlift and walk up to Arang Kel.
Slow drive back down the valley with village stops.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package
tours.note: Foreign nationals may need extra permission for parts of Neelum. Tell us your nationality when you enquire.

tours.title: Swat Valley and Kalam
tours.summary: Malam Jabba, the Ushu forest and Mahodand Lake above Kalam.
tours.season: April to October, Malam Jabba also in winter
tours.alt: The Swat River running through Kalam
plan: Motorway drive to Swat (about 4 hours). Evening in Mingora.
Kalam, the Ushu forest and a jeep to Mahodand Lake in summer.
Swat Museum and Butkara Stupa, then back to Islamabad.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Skardu and Deosai
tours.summary: Kachura lakes, Shigar Fort, the cold desert and the high Deosai plains.
tours.alt: Lower Kachura Lake and Shangrila resort near Skardu
plan: Fly or drive to Skardu. Visit Lower Kachura (Shangrila) Lake.
Upper Kachura Lake, Shigar Fort and the Sarfaranga cold desert.
Full day on the Deosai plains and Sheosar Lake, when the road is open.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package
Flights, if you choose to fly

tours.title: Hunza and Khunjerab (China border)
tours.summary: Baltit and Altit forts, Attabad Lake, the Passu Cones and the China border at Khunjerab Pass.
tours.alt: The Pakistan and China border gate at Khunjerab Pass
plan: Islamabad to Chilas or Naran, depending on the season and road.
Continue on the Karakoram Highway to Hunza. Evening in Karimabad.
Baltit and Altit forts. Sunset at Eagle's Nest viewpoint.
Attabad Lake, Hussaini suspension bridge and the Passu Cones.
Drive to the Pakistan and China border at Khunjerab Pass, then back to Hunza.
Leave Hunza and drive south to Chilas or Naran.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
excl: Meals, unless added to your package
tours.note: Khunjerab Pass is above 4,600 metres and opens only in the warmer months. Bring your CNIC or passport.

tours.title: Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat
tours.summary: A jeep ride and short trek to meadows facing Nanga Parbat, the world's ninth highest mountain.
tours.alt: Pine forest and meadow at Fairy Meadows below snowy peaks
plan: Jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tatoo, then a 2 to 3 hour walk to Fairy Meadows.
Hike towards Beyal Camp and the Nanga Parbat viewpoint.
Walk and jeep back down. Drive to Chilas or Naran.
incl: Hotel stays as agreed in your package
Jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tatoo
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Islamabad City Highlights
tours.summary: Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, Saidpur Village, Daman-e-Koh and dinner at Monal.
tours.start_from: Your hotel in Islamabad or Rawalpindi
tours.alt: Faisal Mosque with the Margalla Hills behind
plan: Faisal Mosque, then the Pakistan Monument and its museum.
Lok Virsa heritage museum. Lunch or hi-tea buffet at Ramada by Wyndham if you like.
incl: Private car with driver for the day
excl: Meals, unless added to your package

tours.title: Lahore Heritage and Food
tours.summary: Lahore Fort, Badshahi Mosque and the Walled City, ending with dinner on Food Street.
tours.alt: Alamgiri Gate and gardens of Lahore Fort
plan: Walk through the Walled City from Delhi Gate to Wazir Khan Mosque.
Dinner on Fort Road Food Street, facing the mosque.
incl: Private car with driver for the day
excl: Meals, unless added to your package
